Render an interactive heatmap

Source: R/interactive.R
calor_girafe.Rd

Wraps ggiraph::girafe() with the plot's natural size and hover styling that dims everything except the hovered cells.

Usage

calor_girafe(plot, ..., hover_css = NULL, dim_css = NULL)

Arguments

plot

A ggcalor() plot with calor_interactive().

...

Passed to ggiraph::girafe().

hover_css

CSS for hovered cells; NULL picks a default.

dim_css

CSS for the other cells while hovering; NULL fades them, or veils them in white for waffles, hex and circle cells and smooth surfaces.

Value

A 'girafe' htmlwidget.
